scope.en: Pinned-source inspection, not execution or reproduction. MetisCraft and Tev1 have separate recorded-run evidence.
scope.zh: 固定源码核查，不等于运行或复现；MetisCraft 与 Tev1 另有原运行证据。

training.en: Candidate-only hard/soft CE; no EOS completion target. The inspected scorer gathers existing LM rows before FP32 multiplication.
training.zh: 候选空间硬／软目标 CE，无 EOS completion 目标。所查评分器先选原始 LM 行，再做 FP32 乘法。

mechanism.en: All choices share one causal prompt; one next-answer position. Endpoint caps and temperature application are separate serving contracts.
mechanism.zh: 所有选项共享一条因果提示，在下一个答案位置读出。端点候选上限及是否应用温度属于另一层服务契约。

zh: 发布物精确维度未核实

training.en: The training path gathers A--Z from full vocabulary logits, masks invalid letters and mixes hard/soft CE. No new scalar head.
training.zh: 训练路径从完整词表 logits 取 A--Z、屏蔽无效字母，使用硬／软 CE 混合目标；不新增标量头。

mechanism.en: Shown: exact training-forward chain. Serving renormalizes a returned top-logprob subset; more than 26 options use chunks, not a single 255-slot head.
mechanism.zh: 图示精确训练前向链。服务另对返回的 top-logprob 子集重归一化；超过 26 选项分块处理，并非单个 255 槽头。

training.en: Independent readout matrix R has shape 255 x 5120. The published inference source does not disclose its training initialization or loss.
training.zh: 独立读出矩阵 R 为 255×5120；发布推理源码未披露训练初始化或目标。

mechanism.en: Full-attention layers see the entire real prompt. This is not standard causal-LM serving; invalid slots are masked before candidate normalization.
mechanism.zh: full-attention 层可见整个有效提示，不等同普通因果 LM 服务；候选归一化前屏蔽无效槽。

training.en: Independent 255 x 5120 readout; initial head and training objective undisclosed. The suffix-end hidden state is read after final normalization.
training.zh: 独立 255×5120 读出；头初始化及训练目标未披露。读出末层归一化后的问题后缀末状态。

mechanism.en: Prefix prefill saves KV, recurrent and convolution state; each suffix forks that state. A suffix sees the prefix and its own text, never another suffix.
mechanism.zh: 前缀预填充保存 KV、循环及卷积状态，各后缀分叉复用；后缀可见前缀及自身，不读取另一题后缀。

training.en: Existing LM head, then slot-ID gather; 256 declared slots. Source loss is candidate CE plus sum-slot Brier, batch mean; released-run settings are author reports.
training.zh: 沿用 LM 头后按槽 ID gather，声明 256 槽；源码目标为候选 CE 加槽内求和 Brier，再取 batch 均值。实际训练设置为作者报告。

mechanism.en: One shared prefix, separate suffix rows and cache forks. The optional pointer head_dim=256 is not a 5120-to-256 MLP in the released slot_lm model.
mechanism.zh: 共享前缀、独立后缀行与缓存分叉；可选 pointer 的 head_dim=256 不是发布 slot_lm 模型中的 5120→256 MLP。

training.en: Pinned release: candidate CE + 0.5 Brier; 12 head-only steps, then full-model tuning. The separate RLCD implementation is not this checkpoint history.
training.zh: 固定发布版：候选 CE＋0.5 Brier；先仅训练头 12 步，再全参训练。另一 RLCD 实现不等于此权重的训练历史。

mechanism.en: Raw pair scores are independent of other candidate texts. Owner grouping and candidate softmax couple probabilities; no shared-prefix tree kernel is implemented.
mechanism.zh: 每对原始分数不依赖其他候选文本；owner 分组后的 softmax 会耦合概率。源码没有共享前缀树 kernel。

training.en: Pinned checkpoint configuration selects candidate CE. Two biased projections d-to-256; pointer scaling by sqrt(256) is distinct from fitted temperature.
training.zh: 固定权重配置采用候选 CE；两个带偏置的 d→256 投影。pointer 的 sqrt(256) 缩放与拟合温度是不同运算。

mechanism.en: Hybrid Kev-4B uses question rows, not the packed mask path. Option ends are causal; the decision query sees all options. Actual head temperature was not read.
mechanism.zh: 混合 Kev-4B 采用逐题行，不执行 packed mask 路径。候选闭合位置因果可见，decision query 读取全部选项；未读取头文件内实际温度。

zh: 所有字段置于同一序列

training.en: Released source exposes inference and head configuration, not the training loss or historical optimization. Model-card base name and config class are recorded separately.
training.zh: 发布源码提供推理与头配置，未给出训练目标和历史优化记录；模型卡基座名称与配置类分别记录。

mechanism.en: Two option-to-memory cross-attention layers, then four field decoder layers. Fields communicate globally; lexical prior plus a gated cosine/MLP term gives scores.
mechanism.zh: 两层候选→memory cross-attention 后接四层字段 decoder；字段全局交互，词面先验加门控 cosine／MLP 项得到分数。

training.en: Native pointer: hard/soft candidate CE. The figure selects residual_dim=0 (default); the optional residual MLP is not silently assumed present.
training.zh: native pointer 使用硬／软候选 CE；图示默认 residual_dim=0，不默认为所有权重添加可选残差 MLP。

mechanism.en: Native source mode, not a pinned HF checkpoint. Rows/packed dispatch depends on the backbone; hybrid Qwen3.5 falls back to question rows.
mechanism.zh: 图示固定工具源码模式，未钉 HF 权重。rows／packed 分派依赖主干；混合 Qwen3.5 回退为逐题行。

en: d and V depend on checkpoint

training.en: Native training uses full-vocabulary CE at the decision position with no EOS target. Inference selects existing frozen LM rows before projection.
training.zh: native 训练在 decision 位置使用全词表 CE，无 EOS 目标；推理先选原始冻结 LM 行，再投影。

mechanism.en: One distinct single-token verbalizer per choice. Training-free choice with alias-logsumexp is another path; it is not mixed into this graph.
mechanism.zh: 每个选项使用不同的单 token verbalizer。含 alias-logsumexp 的 training-free choice 属另一条路径，不混入此图。

training.en: Named multi-label loss branch is BCE; the old checkpoint training history is not recovered. The selected config has no feature L2 or temperature scale.
training.zh: 命名多标签损失分支为 BCE，未恢复旧 checkpoint 训练历史。所选配置不做特征 L2，也不使用温度缩放。

mechanism.en: CLS and label markers see the joint input. Independent d-to-d-to-d projectors give a text/label dot product; per-label sigmoid does not imply independent pairs.
mechanism.zh: CLS 与标签标记可见联合输入；两套 d→d→d 投影后取文本／标签点积。逐标签 sigmoid 不代表独立 pairs。

training.en: Classification uses sum-reduced BCE even when single-label inference selects softmax. The span/count heads are not on this classification path.
training.zh: 分类训练使用求和 BCE，即使单标签推理选择 softmax；span／count 头不在此分类路径上。

mechanism.en: Gather actual [L] markers, skipping [P]; shared d-to-2d ReLU-to-1 MLP. The processor does not insert a CLS readout for this path.
mechanism.zh: gather 实际 [L] 标记并跳过 [P]，共享 d→2d、ReLU、→1 MLP；该处理器不额外插入 CLS 读出。

zh: 局部／全局注意力层交替

training.en: Default student minimizes KL from teacher probabilities; optional gold CE has weight zero by default. Internal classifier is a pinned Transformers structural reference.
training.zh: 默认学生拟合教师分布 KL，可选 gold CE 默认权重为零；内部分类头以固定 Transformers 版本作结构参考。

mechanism.en: Masked mean, Linear-GELU-LayerNorm and a fixed K-class head. Runtime option text is absent; new class names require a new task mapping/head, not just a prompt edit.
mechanism.zh: mask mean 后经 Linear／GELU／LayerNorm 及固定 K 类头。推理不输入候选文本；新类别需要任务映射／头，不能仅改提示。

training.en: Phase 1: independent shared encodings and cosine MSE on same/different-class text pairs. Phase 2: fit multiclass logistic regression on sentence embeddings.
training.zh: 阶段一：共享编码器分别编码同／异类文本对，以 cosine MSE 训练；阶段二：句向量上拟合多类逻辑回归。

mechanism.en: The selected MPNet + sklearn multiclass path has fixed labels and no forced L2 at inference. Body variants and Torch heads are separate supported modes.
mechanism.zh: 图示 MPNet＋sklearn 多类路径，标签固定、推理不强制 L2。其他 body 与 Torch 头是另行选择的模式。

training.en: Official Transformers inference: full vocabulary logits, gather no/yes, normalize those two values. This does not identify the exact training token mask or EOS objective.
training.zh: 官方 Transformers 推理先算词表 logits、取 no／yes 后二列归一化；不能据此推断训练 token mask 或 EOS 目标。

mechanism.en: P(yes) is a pointwise relevance score; no softmax over documents. Q has width 16x128=2048, K/V width 8x128=1024; hidden width is not the head concatenation width. In the index cells, n=no and y=yes.
mechanism.zh: P(yes) 是逐对相关分，不在 document 轴 softmax。Q 宽 16×128=2048，K／V 各宽 8×128=1024；hidden 宽不等于拼头宽。 索引格中 n=no、y=yes。
